title: Toast notifications with a live region
when: The user wants small temporary messages such as Saved, Copied or Upload failed that appear in a corner and fade away.
inputs: whether actions such as Undo are needed
prompt:
Goal: Toasts that screen readers announce, that never steal focus and stay long enough to read.
Steps:
1. The container is in the HTML from the start: <ol class="toasts" role="status" aria-live="polite">, plus a role="alert" container for errors.
2. toast(message, { type, timeout }) builds items with createElement and textContent, each with <button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss">.
3. Success and info leave after about 5 s; errors stay until dismissed; pause timers on hover and focus-within.
4. At most 3 at once, oldest dropped; fixed at the bottom with env(safe-area-inset-bottom), full width on phones.
5. Slide and fade with transform and opacity; only fade under prefers-reduced-motion.
Quality bar:
- Each type has an icon and a word, not only a color.
- Short, specific text (Photo deleted).
- An Undo action stays at least 10 s.
Pitfalls:
- Creating the live region together with the message, so nothing is announced.
- Moving focus to the toast.
- Messages built with innerHTML from data.
Verify:
- [ ] Live containers exist in the initial HTML.
- [ ] Errors stay until dismissed.
- [ ] Text is set with textContent.
- [ ] Reduced motion removes the slide.
Output: Container markup in the page, toast.css and toast.js exporting toast().

examples.input: mensagem de salvo com sucesso no canto da tela
examples.output: status live list, toast("Settings saved") fades after 5 s, error toasts stay with Dismiss
